newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 57 Kurd rebels killed in three days.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 57 Kurd rebels killed in three days.

text.p: Turkish security officials said on Tuesday that government forces had killed 57 Kurdish rebels in separate clashes in the last three days.

The regional governor's office in the city of Diyarbakir said in a statement that the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels had died in fighting in the provinces of Hakkari, Bitlis, Diyarbakir, Tunceli and Bingol.
The statement gave no details of any security forces casualties.
More than 20,000 people have died in 12 years of conflict between troops and the rebels, fighting for Kurdish self-rule in the southeast.
